newsitem.title: PERU: Peru appoints Ludwig Meier new Fisheries Minister.
newsitem.headline: Peru appoints Ludwig Meier new Fisheries Minister.

text.p: The Peruvian government Thursday named Ludwig Meier as new fisheries minister, according to local radio station Cadena Peruana de Noticias.
This portfolio has been vacant since mid-May when former Fisheries Minister Carlos Boggiano resigned due to health problems. The post was temporarily filled by Industry Minister Gustavo Caillaux.

Meier is currently the institutional relations manager of telecommunications company Telefonica del Peru, and previously was the executive secretary of the government promotional body PromPeru. He has also worked as an assistant to ex-Fisheries Minister Ismael Benavides.
